open_findings: F-002 / F-019 RESOLVED 2026-08-30, TARGET STILL MISSED: a 50% minimum relative action-gain rule was selected from 30 strategies across three seeds and 300 labelled anchors. Mean seeded false interventions fell 88.96% -> 68.79%; catch stayed 100% and empirical ungrounded escapes stayed 0%. Anchor false interventions fell 94.81% -> 51.11% with baseline catch/escapes unchanged at 96.67%/3.33%. Absolute probability and stakes gates reduced false interventions further but were rejected because escapes increased. Every clean seeded case above Rs.10,000 still intervenes, so the global 2% target remains an open release miss rather than being tuned away.

fixed_this_session: the calibration set was 50% defective, so the calibrator scored clean text at P=0.135 and HELD CORRECT ANSWERS for review. Base rate corrected to 10%; ECE 0.0451 -> 0.0037.

the conformal threshold was certified against the BINARY fusion but applied to the per-defect P(ungrounded) the engine gates on. Two different scales, nothing raised; guaranteed mode was a silent no-op and the only symptom was two identical eval columns.

'Let me search the documents again.' scored P(ungrounded)=0.95 and at Rs.75,000 was BLOCKED. Grounding is now gated on is_claim_bearing() -- a sentence asserting nothing checkable is not scored for groundedness.

F-019 production rule: ordinary interventions must reduce expected loss by at least 50% relative to L0_pass; hard rules and unavailable-action constraints run first and cannot be overridden.
rework confidence scaled from zero at the similarity bar, making the bar meaningless -- a match that just cleared it charged nothing. Now has an explicit floor.
fairness extractor flagged a paraphrased approval as bias; decided-vs-unreadable is now extraction_uncertain, not disparity.
judge confidence parser dropped any value with trailing punctuation ('confidence 0.85.'), silently losing every stated confidence.

TRAIN/SERVE SKEW in the observer probe: trained with untrusted passages in the premise, served without them. Cost ~0.07 AUROC (0.907 -> 0.837) and nothing errored -- it would have read as 'the probe is weak'. Training now matches serving; serving is the side that cannot move, because a poisoned document in the premise makes the attacker's own claim genuinely entailed.

observe_deadline_ms was 120 ms, but the observer probe costs ~100 ms and the claim verifier another ~100 -- so the probe could NEVER have run in production, and neither could both signals together. The 120 ms figure treated Lane B as if it were on the critical path; it is not, it runs concurrently with generating the next sentence (1-3 s locally) behind the commit buffer. Raised to 800 ms, which is comfortably under the generator and over both signals. What is actually spent shows up as `gate_hold` in /admin/latency, which is the number to watch rather than the ceiling.

LEAKAGE (D4-B6): calibration drew from all 45 corpus documents and the eval set from 43 of them. Different seeds gave different triples, so it looked fine, but the calibrator had read every document the eval set was built from. Now partitioned BY DOCUMENT, stratified by domain, zero shared -- and re-measured. ECE unchanged (0.0037), false interventions 91.08% -> 85.35%, and verification cost 3.60% -> 5.20%, which now MISSES its target: the leak had been hiding it.

the first version of that split was unstratified, which sent every branch_info and fees document to the calibration side. The eval set then had no low-stakes traffic at all -- 128 of 157 clean cases at Rs.10,000+, the Rs.0-100 band gone, false interventions reading 100%. The number was measuring the split. Now hashed WITHIN each domain.

deviations_recorded: D-009: the dense retrieval arm is a hashed lexical vector, not bge-small-en-v1.5 (no torch). BM25 carries retrieval; declares semantic=False and gets half a vote.
D-010: calibration is fitted on INDUCED failures, not human labels. The 300 human-labelled calibration anchors are now present as a secondary audit, but they are not an untouched holdout.

D-011: `make eval` holds generation FIXED across both arms (paired design). This is a methodological choice, not a shortcut -- it attributes every off-vs-on difference to Interlock rather than to sampling noise -- but it means generation latency and billing are modelled rather than observed.

D-012: the plan names DeBERTa-v3-base for the observer. transformers 5.x cannot load its tokenizer -- it misroutes the SentencePiece model to the tiktoken parser, which fails on the binary file, and installing sentencepiece/tiktoken does not help because the routing happens before either is consulted. The encoder is configurable and defaults to an NLI cross-encoder whose tokenizer loads natively; NLI is arguably the better base since grounding IS entailment.
